instruction: Run these with the installed skill and isolated supplied fixtures. Evaluate observable actions/artifacts; do not infer a pass from a good-sounding answer.

cases.request: Create a short educational video from my repeated takes. Study this accessible reference, ask about destination and mode, clean up natural pauses and color, and show every section before final output.
cases.fixture_needed: Creator-authorized raw footage with repeated complete/incomplete takes, an accessible reference, and optional brand inputs.
pass: Take selection has evidence and rationale
All scenes/captions and motion samples previewed
Guided final waits for actual approval
No invented performance claims or paid API

cases.request: Use my approved master. Do not change its audio, cuts, speed or retouch. Add real product footage in automatic mode and return the video and editable project.
cases.fixture_needed: Approved master with speech and supporting real recordings covering all required intervals.
pass: Every spoken feature maps to correct visual
No extra approval imposed in selected automatic mode

cases.request: The private payment recording is unavailable and I cannot supply it. Finish with the available footage; a generated illustration may help explain the idea.
cases.fixture_needed: Real authorized footage missing an essential private transaction view.
pass: Missing footage requested once or prior decline respected

cases.request: Keep my spoken credit/cash terms exact. Add readable Persian captions with an English product name and amounts.
cases.fixture_needed: Persian speech, known corrected transcript and a font with appropriate glyphs.
pass: Uncertain words reviewed rather than guessed

cases.request: Translate this sentence and schedule an Instagram post for next week.
pass: Does not start a video-edit workflow for plain translation
Does not claim publishing/account management support
